thread:
alice: Alert from SLO watch — paging canary (sdk-pagination-v2) spike in 502s and streaming handshake fails after last deploy. immediate customer reports.

alice: error sample from canary instance:
```
2026-03-15T14:05:12Z ERROR rpc: downstream 502 Bad Gateway: upstream read timeout
stream_handshake: client_id=abc123; err=EOF; proto=webrtc/stream-v1
```

incident-bot: Incident created: paging-canary-compatibility-failure. Severity: HIGH. Paging route /v2/paging shows 35% error rate over 5m. Paging canary tag: sdk-pagination-v2.

raj: I’m on it — taking pager. Starting triage. Which deploy rolled this out?

tom: rollout initiated from ci/deploy 2026-03-15T13:58 by release-bot. Canary was to 5% of traffic, but looks like traffic routing overlapped with prod clients due to header mismatch in SDK 2.0.0.

maya: Confirmed: SDK 2.0.0 changed the paging protocol header from X-Paging-Token -> X-Pg-Token. Older routing rules only match old name, so canary routing mistakenly forwarded to new handler which returns 502 for older clients.

nina: Support flags: multiple customers reported failed pagination calls and partial render loops — ACME and BetaCorp flagged. Escalated to CSMs.

raj: Ok mitigation options: 1) Kill the feature flag that sends traffic to canary 2) Rollback canary 3) Add header compatibility in gateway (fast patch). Which is fastest? 

maya: Feature flag ff/pagination-v2-kill exists. Can flip immediately, route 100% back to stable. I can flip now if we want minimal blast radius.

tom: If we kill the flag, we need to confirm the gateway doesn't cache new handler responses. Also rolling back the deployment would be cleaner. I can trigger a rollback to sha abcde1233 which is the previous stable image.

alice: Prioritize kill-switch + rollback in parallel. Kill-switch first to stop customer impact, then rollback to fix canary build.

maya: Flipping ff/pagination-v2-kill -> ON (kill) now.

deploy-bot: ff/pagination-v2-kill toggled to ON by maya at 2026-03-15T14:08:33. Traffic routed away from canary.

raj: Monitoring error rate and customer reports. Metrics: error rate dropped from 35% -> 6% in 60s. Good sign.

nina: Support: initial customer triage: send ETA and workaround: advise using legacy SDK or retry with header X-Paging-Token. Sending templated note.

tom: Starting rollback to stable image abcde1233 now. Command:
```
ci rollback --env=prod --service=paging --to=abcde1233 --reason="canary header mismatch"
```

deploy-bot: Rollback job queued (job 9876). Estimated completion 2-4m.

incident-bot: On-call handoff scheduled: raj -> alice at 14:20 UTC. Add postmortem lead.

raj: While rollback runs, can we add a temporary gateway translation rule to rewrite X-Pg-Token -> X-Paging-Token for affected requests? If rollout lingers it'd reduce impact.

maya: I can patch gateway rule in-flight. Adding header rewrite middleware for /v2/paging for 30m.

maya: Applied temporary rewrite. Rule id rw-451 applied at 14:11:12.

raj: Rollback completed. deploy-bot: job 9876 finished; new running image abcde1233 on all paging nodes.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 2026-03-15T14:12:58. Canary instances drained.

alice: Verifying end-to-end. Current error rate 0.8% (baseline 0.5%). Customer reports decreasing.

nina: Sent update to ACME & BetaCorp; they confirmed reduced failures. Marking P1 customer impact reduced.

tom: Planning follow-ups: 1) revert temporary gateway rewrite 2) block the 2.0.0 SDK until compatibility changes landed 3) create canary gating test for header changes.

maya: Will remove rewrite at 14:30 unless we need extension. Noted on canary test.

raj: Assign postmortem: alice will own. Timeline: incident created 14:06, kill-switch 14:08, rollback 14:12, mitigated 14:13. Root cause: SDK 2.0.0 header rename + routing rules mismatch + insufficient canary header compatibility testing.

alice: I'll open postmortem doc and include RCA, timeline, mitigation, and action items: - blocker: gate SDK breaking changes behind staged handshake AND client compatibility tests - create runbook for header rename rollouts - increase canary isolation for header/schema changes.

incident-bot: Incident marked: resolved. Resolution summary posted to #incidents. Postmortem assigned to alice. Severity downgraded to MEDIUM for follow-up.

alice: Thanks everyone. Closing thread once postmortem linked.

tom: Quick note: will create a temporary release-blocking CI job that checks for header renames in SDK diff. :+1:

nina: Support will follow up with customers and tag in postmortem. Closing on our side.

maya: Removing temporary gateway rewrite now (rw-451 removed at 14:29:50).

alice: Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/paging-canary-compat-2026-03-15 (draft). Will update and tag owners.

raj: Good job team. Recommend adding a monitoring alert for header mismatch rate on canaries.

alice: noted. Closing incident in 30m unless new issues arise. :white_check_mark:
